recipe.title: Siniyet Kafta — Lebanese Baked Kafta with Potatoes
recipe.description: Herby parsley-and-onion beef kafta patties baked in a tray under sliced potatoes and tomatoes, everything browned at the edges and soaked in garlicky tomato juices. Lightened with 93% lean beef and olive oil instead of the usual fatty mince and butter.

ingredients.amount: 500 g, scrubbed, skin on, sliced 5 mm

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.content: Heat the main oven to 220C/425F. Use a 9x13-inch baking dish or similar tray.

steps.title: Mix the kafta
steps.content: Grate or very finely mince 60 g of the onion and squeeze out excess liquid. Mix it into the beef with the parsley, 1 tsp of the garlic, allspice, cumin, cinnamon, salt and pepper. Knead 1 minute until tacky — that binds it without egg.

steps.title: Shape and lay in the tray
steps.content: Form 6 flattened oval patties about 1.5 cm thick and lay them in a single layer in the tray with a little space between. Brush with 5 g of the olive oil.

steps.title: Slice and season the potatoes and tomatoes
steps.content: Slice the potatoes 5 mm thick (skin on), the tomatoes 5 mm, and the remaining 60 g onion thin. Toss potatoes and onion with 15 g olive oil, paprika, oregano, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Build the tray
steps.content: Shingle the potatoes and onion over and around the kafta, then tuck the tomato slices between them. Whisk the tomato paste, broth, remaining 1 tsp garlic and a pinch of salt and pour it around the edges of the tray — not over the top, so the potatoes can brown.

steps.title: Bake covered
steps.content: Cover tightly with foil and bake at 220C/425F for 30 minutes, until the potatoes are tender when pierced.

steps.title: Uncover and brown
steps.content: Remove the foil, brush the potato tops with the last 5 g olive oil, and bake 18-22 more minutes until the potato edges are crisp and browned and the juices are thick and bubbling. Pro tip: if the tops are still pale, broil 2-3 minutes, watching closely.

steps.title: Rest and finish
steps.content: Rest 5 minutes off the heat, squeeze over the juice of half the lemon, scatter any leftover parsley, and serve with lemon wedges. Spoon the pan juices over each plate.

recipe.notes: Per serving (of 2): ~44 g protein, ~610 cal, ~6 g saturated fat, 0 g added sugar, ~9 g fiber. New buys: 93% lean ground beef, fresh parsley, extra virgin olive oil, chicken broth, lemon, ground allspice, cumin, cinnamon (the spices last months and show up again). Storage: keeps 3 days covered; reheat in the Tovala on Steam 6 min then Broil Lo 2 min so the potatoes crisp again instead of going soggy. Pro tips: squeeze the grated onion dry or the patties steam instead of browning; keep potato slices an even 5 mm so they finish together; don't pour the sauce over the potatoes. Liver note: lean 93% beef, olive oil instead of butter or ghee, skin-on potatoes for fiber, and acid from lemon and tomato instead of a sugary sauce — the dish is already Mediterranean, just lightened at the fat.
